definitions.explanation: The time of day when the sun sets and darkness begins to fall.

examples.japanese: {日暮|ひぐ}れ⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{帰|かえ}ろう→帰る：00508_kaeru⟧。
{日暮|ひぐ}れ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{空|そら}→空：02216_sora⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{美|うつく}しい→美しい：01121_utsukushii⟧。
examples.english: The sky at dusk is beautiful.
Since sunset is late in summer, you can play outside for a long time.

notes:
Refers to the time when the sun sets and daylight fades. Emphasizes the transition from day to night, often implying a deadline — things that should be done before dark.

ETYMOLOGY:
Compound of ⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧ (sun/day) + ⟦{暮|く}れ→暮れ：02671_kure⟧ (setting, ending). Literally "the day's end."

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {日暮|ひぐ}れ⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: by sunset/nightfall
- {日暮|ひぐ}れ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{空|そら}→空：02216_sora⟧: the sky at dusk
- {日暮|ひぐ}れ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{早|はや}い→早い：00514_hayai⟧/⟦{遅|おそ}い→遅い：00533_osoi⟧: sunset is early/late (seasonal)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{夕暮|ゆうぐ}れ→夕暮れ：07682_yuugure⟧: evening, twilight (very close, slightly more poetic and literary)
- ⟦{日没|にちぼつ}→日没：04657_nichibotsu⟧: sunset (technical/formal, as in weather reports)
- ⟦{夕方|ゆうがた}→夕方：01010_yuugata⟧: evening (more everyday, refers to the time period)
- ⟦{黄昏|たそがれ}→黄昏：05046_tasogare⟧: dusk, twilight (literary)
